name: Malt-O-Meal Original Hot Farina ("Brulee" Style)
whyItWorks: Finely milled wheat endosperm (~1g fiber), fortified with iron and B vitamins, requiring zero mechanical grinding for the bowel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook smooth with lactose-free or oat milk. Top with a thin pat of butter and 1 tsp brown sugar (melted on top), or swirl in 1 tbsp smooth peanut butter and pure maple syrup.
